text: {"lessons":["My account fell about 8% from Period 1 to Period 4, but a short run of losses does not tell me what prices will do next.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should avoid panic-selling and instead make measured decisions consistent with my risk tolerance.","Doing nothing was reasonable when I had no clear reason to trade; I should review periodically and trade only when a deliberate decision warrants it."]}
